en: A propaganda-style postcard dominated by a large red illustration of an Austrian postage stamp showing the left-facing profile of Emperor Franz Joseph I. Around the portrait is German text identifying the Austro‑Hungarian imperial and royal post. The stamp bears the year 1914 and a value of 10 Heller, surrounded by decorative laurel motifs. Below the oversized stamp, in bold red Gothic script, is a German slogan urging people to buy war stamps and use them on their letters; smaller explanatory text follows.
